title: Excellence in Customer Service
overview: This course covers all essential aspects of service that anyone engaged in direct customer interactions should master and apply. From the necessary behavioral and communication skills to the right mindset, and including specific methods for analyzing and improving service delivery, this course offers a clear and effective approach. Participants will learn how to ensure customer satisfaction and delight, even in the most challenging situations
audience: This course is designed for customer service representatives, technical and support staff, field service agents, account managers, credit and billing specialists, and managers seeking customer service training to enhance their skills and train their teams.
methodology: A variety of methodologies are employed in this course. In addition to concise presentations by our consultants, we utilize case studies, self-assessment exercises, practical exercises, video clips, and role-playing to reinforce the methods learned
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Articulate the importance of customer service in a competitive landscape
Emphasize the crucial role of internal customers and demonstrate how their satisfaction is key to organizational success
Apply techniques to manage customer expectations and exceed them
Deliver faster, better service to increase customer satisfaction
Identify early signs of customer dissatisfaction and respond effectively to resolve issues
